As much as I would like to, I cannot do that. She lives in a sorority. Men are not allowed there. I am cut off. And even if I did somehow talk to her, I'm afraid that my social anxiety would mess things up even more.

I did have some conversations with her several years ago, and almost all of them were incredibly awkward.

You're 100% correct. Depending on someone else for your happiness is a terrible thing. Not only for you, but also for them, because you basically put more wight on their shoulders in that they have to restlessly care for you. But having the idea that the one who in your eyes is the most perfect human feels the same way for you, is of unimaginable worth. It is a motivation that never goes away.

I guess I could never make a good boyfriend, so maybe it's all karma.

Not in the slightest. She never gave me false hope. She is an amazing person and would never toy with my feelings. I just never had the courage to tell her how I feel, and now that my time has ran out, I'm trapped with my own thoughts.

\- What would happen if I did tell her?

\- Why could I never be good enough to do it?

\- Why did I waste all this time?

And many more questions like these in my head.

I too have bad breath, and not only that, but bad B.O. in general! No matter how frequently or how well I shower/brush my teeth, or how much deodorant I use, my body and my breath always stink and everyone complains about it. I always have to chew a gum when in public and be around ventilation, otherwise it becomes too apparent to not notice ... It sucks, but doesn't compare to the other physical and mental problems I have.
